verdict.rationale: Neon's core product is Postgres branching that copies both schema and data via copy-on-write storage, with dedicated docs (neon-docs-25 Branching, neon-docs-8/29 Instant restore), CLI support, and independent community confirmation of the branch-and-reset workflow against production data (neon-comm-10). Copilot agent docs further describe running migrations on temporary branches to keep production untouched (neon-supp-copilot-agents), corroborating real-world dev/test usage. Missing for 10: a hands-on benchmark of branch creation speed/independent verification beyond one HN comment.
